independently selected canonical-66 passages listed here

chunks.form: superscription and storm-theophany with refuge-versus-enemy close
chunks.marker: Burden/vision heading opens sustained attribute-and-theophany poetry; repeated divine naming, landscape dissolution, rhetorical question, refuge turn, and flood/enemy contrast form one larger opening.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not reconstruct a complete acrostic, atomize attributes as doctrine, or decide author/date/layers/history/ethics/text.
chunks.risk: Heading relation, Exodus-formula reuse, acrostic traces, rare words, flood imagery, referents, theology, and ethics remain unresolved.

chunks.form: rhetorical challenge, total-end declaration, and wicked-counsel emergence
chunks.marker: What-do-you-plot opens a compact address; ending language and thorn/drunken-stubble similes culminate in one-who-plots-evil.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep the ambiguous sequence together; identify no addressee, counselor, city, ruler, event, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Speaker/addressee, pronouns, counselor identity, similes, history, chronology, and reuse remain unresolved.

chunks.form: alternating decree of broken yoke and ended hostile name followed by Zion good-news summons
chunks.marker: Thus-says-YHWH introduces decree; yoke, cut-off name, grave verdict, and behold-on-the-mountains proclamation lead to feast/vow imperatives amid addressee shifts.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not force pronouns to Judah, Nineveh, Assyria, or a king, or turn good news into fulfillment authority.
chunks.risk: Addressee alternation, name/idol/grave, Zion/Judah, good-news reuse, versification, chronology, history, and fulfillment remain unresolved.

chunks.form: scatterer siege summons juxtaposed with Jacob-Israel restoration rationale
chunks.marker: Scatterer announcement drives defensive imperatives; for-YHWH-restores supplies rationale and a plundered-vine contrast before the battle tableau.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve the summons/rationale pair without identifying scatterer, defender, polity, invasion, restoration program, or chronology.
chunks.risk: English/Hebrew numbering, addressees, restoration, identity, and history remain unresolved.

chunks.form: kinetic siege, breached-city collapse, flight, plunder, and desolation tableau
chunks.marker: Shield, chariot, street, officer, gate, palace, river/queen, maid, flight, plunder, and emptied-heart images accelerate from approach through collapse.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize battle images or resolve rare words, queen/river readings, battle reconstruction, chronology, or ethics.
chunks.risk: Viewpoint, rare forms, 2:7 figure, commands, battle sequence, violence, history, and witnesses remain unresolved.

chunks.form: lion-den taunt answered by terminal divine-warrior verdict
chunks.marker: Where-is-the-lions-den opens a lion/prey family image; behold-I-am-against-you shifts to verdict and silences messengers.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep taunt and verdict together; decide no empire identity, ethnic stereotype, conquest ethic, violence doctrine, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Lion symbolism, household imagery, prey/sword, messenger voice, referents, ethics, theology, and history remain unresolved.

chunks.form: blood-city woe, battle catalogue, exploitation accusation, and exposure verdict
chunks.marker: Woe catalogs deceit, plunder, battle sound, bodies, prostitution, and sorcery; behold-I-am-against-you turns accusation into exposure, flight, and unanswered lament.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not turn violent, sexualized, gendered, imperial, or shame imagery into timeless ethnic, political, or ethical authority.
chunks.risk: City identity, bodies, sexualized metaphor, exposure, gender ethics, trauma, history, and application remain unresolved.

chunks.form: Thebes comparison, remembered exile, and fortress-collapse argument
chunks.marker: Are-you-better-than-No-Amon begins comparison with waters, allies, exile, infants, nobles, and chains; you-also leads to ripe-fig fortresses and opened gates.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify No-Amon/Thebes, allies, army, event, or date beyond received labels or harmonize campaigns.
chunks.risk: Place identification, geography, exile, infant violence, defender language, chronology, harmonization, and ethics remain unresolved.

chunks.form: futile siege-preparation imperatives and merchant-official locust swarm taunt
chunks.marker: Defense imperatives mock preparation because fire/sword consume; multiply-like-locust pivots into merchants, guards, scribes, swarms, and flight.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not separate every command, office, or insect stage, resolve rare terms, or identify siege, personnel, ethics, or chronology.
chunks.risk: Imperative irony, fire/sword, locust forms, official terms, flight, wording, history, and ethics remain unresolved.

chunks.form: royal funeral-lament close with scattered people, incurable wound, and nations' clap
chunks.marker: Address to king of Assyria gathers sleeping shepherds, resting nobles, scattered people, unhealed fracture, evil report, and hand-clap into a terminal lament/taunt.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep the close intact; identify no king/date and authorize no celebration of suffering, collective guilt, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Sleep/death, shepherd/noble relations, king identity, wound, clap, ethics, history, chronology, and fulfillment remain unresolved.
